title: K-ON!: Live House!
justification: AniList 6862 (OVA, 1 episode(s) from 2010-01-19) is AniDB 6257's special(s) S2, aired 2010-01-20. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 5680, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 6257, and the special's title (Live House!) matches an AniList title. The parent's node, as overlay/6257.json patches it, places S2 on TVDB 0x19 Live House!, 2010-01-20. TMDB 42253 season 0 lists the same episode as S0E9 Live House!, 2010-01-20, but Anime-Lists' TMDB side still sends every K-On! special to S0E<n> (S0E2 is Yui's Curiosity Series), a franchise-wide TMDB numbering fault shared with AniDB 7307 and 8280 that this entry does not touch.
